sec: sec:E009: Monitor third-party access / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:E009: Monitor third-party access / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Configuring logging for third-party interactions. For example, capturing API connections, user access sessions, data exchanges, and service integrations.

sentences.text: For example, capturing API connections, user access sessions, data exchanges, and service integrations.

blocks.id: blk:E009: Monitor third-party access / Control shoulds/2
blocks.text: Capturing access metadata. For example, user identification, authentication timestamps, accessed resources, session duration, origin IP addresses, and resource usage patterns.

sentences.text: For example, user identification, authentication timestamps, accessed resources, session duration, origin IP addresses, and resource usage patterns.
